newsitem.title: USA: Emery Worldwide forms Taiwan company.
newsitem.headline: Emery Worldwide forms Taiwan company.

text.p: Emery Worldwide said it has converted its agent operation in Taiwan into a wholly owned company offering international air, ocean, customs brokerage, logistics and bonded warehousing services.

Taiwan is the sixth country in the past two years where Emery has converted agent operations into wholly owned, full service units, the company said. The others were in Chile, Argentina, Venezuela, Hungary, Finland and Portugal.
James Lee has been named managing director of the new company, which has offices in Taipei and Kaoshiung, Emery said.
